title: Tempeh masala with spinach
summary: Tempeh masala with spinach is a indian dinner built around tempeh and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Tempeh masala with spinach. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add tempeh and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and baby spinach.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Tempeh masala with spinach before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Tempeh masala with spinach.
